paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tzor.

In Ketubot 7a: Rabbi Abbahu said: Rabbi Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tzor asked Rabbi Yohanan in Tzaidan. And we find in Berakhot 33a: Rabbi Yose (read: Assi) — and some say Rabbi Shimon ben Yaakov of Tzor — asked Rabbi Yohanan [in Tzaidan, Dikdukei Soferim]. It is very plausible to say that in both places the reading should be either Rabbi Yishmael or Rabbi Shimon.

notes.text: The checked passages retain Yishmael in Ketubot and Yose or Shimon in Berakhot. Hyman’s corrections to Assi and to one common name remain his proposals.
